description: EPF Scheme para 26A(2) proviso: an employer may restrict its contribution to the notified ceiling of 15000.0000 even where the statutory wage is higher. Hand derivation: statutory wage 40000.0000 with base CEILING gives a statutory base of min(40000.0000, 15000.0000) = 15000.0000 and NO above-ceiling excess, so EPF wages 15000.0000; EPS wages are min(statutory wage, pension ceiling) = 15000.0000 and EDLI wages likewise 15000.0000; employee 12% of 15000.0000 = 1800; EPS 8.33% of 15000.0000 = 1249.5000 -> 1250; employer residual 1800 - 1250 = 550. The point of this fixture is that every figure is IDENTICAL to the at-ceiling case even though the wage is 40000.0000 — it is the cap that decides, not the wage.
